items.q: Why does my score change between tests?
items.a: Network conditions and server load vary, so scores shift a little each time. Run it a few times and look at the trend.

items.q: What should I fix first to improve speed?
items.a: Compress and resize images, reduce unused scripts, enable caching and avoid heavy pop-ups. The tool lists simple fixes in order.

items.q: Is the page speed checker free?
items.a: Yes. The page speed checker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: How does it test my page?
items.a: It uses Google's PageSpeed Insights service to test the page you enter. No login is needed and your page's public address is the only thing sent.

items.q: Can you make my website faster?
items.a: Yes. Speed work, including slow WordPress fixes, is part of our website team's service.
